title: Demo materials: the made-up kick-off transcript and the "what we want" sheet
story: Before a demo, the cast opens the demo folder, pastes the kick-off chat in step 3, answers every question from the one-page sheet, and pastes the customer email in step 9. Each step's pass condition says whether release 1 holds.
no_qa_reason: Documents only; nothing in the app to drive.
